# Tindrop

> Tindrop is an iOS and Android app for reviewing, cleaning, organizing and rediscovering photos and videos one decision at a time.

Official product page: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/
Download router: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/go/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/tindrop/id6756980913
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tindrop.tindrop
Privacy: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/privacy.html
Terms: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/terms.html
Support: lagartijalabs@gmail.com
Cleanup guides: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/guias/

## What Tindrop does

- Reviews one photo or video at a time with a card-based gesture flow.
- Swipes right to keep, left to stage for deletion review, and down to classify into collections.
- Requires a review and confirmation step before selected local items move to the device trash or Recently Deleted area.
- Scans for exact duplicate photos, groups the copies and lets the user choose which copies to remove.
- Offers short Daily Clean sessions that help prevent the camera roll from piling up again.
- Reviews photos from the local device, Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox.
- Creates and manages colored photo collections while reviewing.
- Backs up and restores saved, trashed, statistics and collection state.
- Creates shareable music collages from saved photos or collections.

## Privacy and accuracy notes

Tindrop processes the local photo library on the user's device and does not upload that library to a Tindrop server. Connected cloud sources require network access and are accessed through the selected provider. Tindrop's duplicate cleaner is described as detecting exact copies; the product page does not claim that visual similarity alone is enough for automatic deletion.

## Spanish summary

Tindrop es una app para iPhone y Android que permite limpiar y organizar fotos y vídeos con gestos. El usuario conserva, clasifica o envía cada elemento a revisión, confirma antes de borrar y puede trabajar con la galería local, Google Drive, OneDrive y Dropbox.

## Camera roll cleanup guides

- How to clean up a camera roll without losing important photos: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/guias/como-limpiar-galeria-movil/
- How to delete duplicate photos on iPhone safely: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/guias/eliminar-fotos-duplicadas-iphone/
- How to free device storage without losing photos: https://lagartijalabs.com/tindrop/guias/liberar-espacio-sin-perder-fotos/

The guides distinguish device storage from cloud storage, synchronization from independent backup, exact duplicates from visually similar shots, and pending review from permanent deletion. Operational claims about Apple Photos, iCloud Photos and Google Photos are linked to the relevant official support documentation in each article. Product-specific recommendations are limited to features that Tindrop currently exposes: photo-by-photo review, exact duplicate grouping, collections, cloud-source switching and confirmation before deletion.
